comment: Policy for src/gate.mjs (the pre-sign gate). Rules 1-2 use maxAnchorAgeH and maxDailyUsd. Rule 3 (counterparty) uses self, allow, trustedApis, humanApproved and block. Every entry says where it came from. Addresses are public contracts or APIs, or the agent's own public addresses (self), never a person's wallet. The agent's gate uses only the version published on GitHub main, so a change counts once it is public. priceCeilings (2026-11-07): every amount the gate cannot price exactly (only USDG is $1) is counted at a published upper price per chain and token ('native' = the chain's own coin); rule 2 counts the larger of that and the caller's figure, and an amount with no ceiling is refused. A ceiling below the market lets a caller understate by at most market/ceiling.

self.label: the agent's wallet (same key on every EVM chain it uses: Robinhood Chain, HyperEVM, Elysium)

trustedApis.label: NEAR Intents 1Click: a new deposit address for every quote

trustedApis.statusRule: added 2026-11-06: the gate reads 1Click's own record of the deposit address before the send; it must be PENDING_DEPOSIT, pay an address in self and refund to an address in self
